verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 80.9 (+0.9% in a day) and momentum is 47: prices are steady. 84s cost 850, 85s 2,000 and 86s 5,400. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-20T16:36:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Simone Laudehr 88 Base Hero after its 40% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 88,000 coins. Now 79,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 39.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 6 of 12 so far, averaging +5.6% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy 86-rated fodder after Rivals rewards, sell or use by Saturday
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 4,500 coins. Now 5,400. Rivals rewards dip: Rivals rewards flood the market with fodder on Thursday morning, and SBC demand lifts it again by the weekend. Picked because it is the cheapest 86 is 4,500 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 4 so far, averaging +10.1% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 85s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 850 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,000 (0.95 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,400 (1.32 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,500 (1.36 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,000 (1.45 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 85s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Jobe Bellingham and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Jobe Bellingham 77 Rare -35.2%; Carla Andrés 76 Rare -30.9%; Tarik Muharemović 75 Rare -28.0%; Marcus Rashford 82 Rare -25.8%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
